newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan FGEP group to tender for 54,000T US corn.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan FGEP group to tender for 54,000T US corn.

text.p: Taiwan's FGEP group would tender later on Tuesday for a 54,000-tonne shipment of U.S. corn, traders said.
Shipment would be slated for February 10-25 from the U.S. Gulf or February 26 to March 13 from the Pacific Northwest, they said.
The FGEP group last entered the grain market on October 24, buying two 54,000-tonne shipments of U.S. corn at tender.
The FGEP buying group comprises Fwu Sow Grain, Great Wall Enterprises, President Enterprises and unlisted Ever Smile Feed Mill Co.
